decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>Use Class Restrictions&nbsp;</p><p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General&nbsp; Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any equivalent section of any subsequent order revoking and re-enacting that&nbsp; order with or without modification), no change of use shall be permitted under Schedule 2, Part 3, Class MA of that Order shall take place. The ground floor commercial hereby approved shall only operate under Class E (c) of the Use Class Order 1987 (as amended) unless prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p><br></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Disposal of Water</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of sewage and surface water have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The works shall thereafter be retained</span></p>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Approved Plans</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Drawing 90 001 P01 – Site Location Plan; Drawing 90 002 P01 – Site Plan Existing; Drawing 90 003 P01 – Site Plan Proposed; Drawing 01 001 P01 – Level 00 Existing Plan [Ground Floor]; Drawing 01 002 - Level 01 Existing Plan [First Floor]; Drawing 01 004 - Level 01 Existing Plan [Second Floor]; Drawing 01 004 P01 – Roof Existing Plan [Ground Floor Drawing 01 005 P01 – Level 00 Proposed Plan [Ground Floor]; Drawing 01 006 - Level 01 Proposed Plan [First Floor]; Drawing 01 007 P01 – Level 02 Proposed Plan [Second Floor]; Drawing 01 008 P01 – Roof Proposed Plan [Second Floor]; Drawing 02 001 P01 – Elevations Existing;&nbsp; Drawing 02 002 P01 – Elevations 2 Existing;&nbsp; Drawing 02 003 P01 – Elevations Proposed; Drawing 02 004 P01 –Elevations 2 Proposed; Drawing 02 005 P01 – Refuse Store Elevations; Drawing 04 001 P01 – Shadow Study Summer; Drawing 04 002 P01 – Shadow Study Winter; Fire Safety – Reasonable Exemption Statement; Design &amp; Access Statemen by For Senses</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">All documents received valid on 14.10.24</span></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Green Roof</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development shall not progress beyond damp proof course until details of the provision of green/biodiverse roofs and living wall within the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details to be submitted shall comprise:</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">a) identification of the roof areas to be used for the provision of green/biodiverse roofs;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">b) details of the planting and substrate to be used, including roof build up, plant species/mix(es) schedule which should include at least 20 native flower species, plans and sections as appropriate; and</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">c) details of the maintenance including irrigation.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained and maintained as such thereafter.</span></p><p><br></p><div><br></div>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Refuse and Recycling Storage </span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Notwithstanding any hereby approved plans and documents, prior to occupation, revised details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, confirming the refuse storage doors do not open outside of the application’s redline boundary. The waste and recycling storage shall then be implemented in accordance with these approved details for both residential and commercial unit prior to the first occupation of the development, and retained thereafter. The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the thereby approved designated refuse storage area</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">No Upper Floor Windows&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the eastern flank or northern rear elevation at first or second floor level of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p><div style=""><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Fire Safety&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Notwithstanding any hereby approved plans and documents, prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a Planning Fire Safety Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include further details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</span></p><p><br></p>

<p>Cycle Storage</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details for replacement cycle storage for the existing / enlarged residential units. The storage provision shall be in place prior to occupation of the approved extension or loss of the current site storage (whichever occurs first), and retained thereafter.</p>
description: Three storey rear extension incorporating enlargement of existing flats to create (2 x 1 beds & 2 x 2 beds); office use (Class E) on ground floor; bin stores with green roof to rear; external alterations
